name: "Calm" - Carter's Notes

description.content: Increases your Terror Radius by [8m] while [Static Blast] is ready, and decreases it by [8m] while [Static Blast] is on cooldown.
Survivors with [Madness] suffer from the [Affliction of Calm]:

items: [Madness II]: Intermittently hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.
[Madness III]: Constantly hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.

quote: "Higher quality seizures trigger catatonia. At least it gives me peace for the time it lasts." -H. Carter
